description.text: The seventh Scarlet & Violet set, released on 13 September 2024 with 175 cards. It brought the first cards of the Legendary Terapagos and the Stellar Tera type, with Cinderace ex, Lapras ex and Galvantula ex as Stellar Tera Pokémon ex, beside the newly discovered Hydrapple ex, and new-style basic Energy. It draws on The Indigo Disk, and its rarest cards include three gold etched hyper rares.
